# 62days

> > A secure online marketplace for selling luxury jewellery, watches, diamonds, and antiques with instant valuations and free collection service.

62days is a trusted platform specializing in the second-hand market for high-value items including jewelry, precious metals, luxury watches, and collectibles. The service offers expert valuations, secure transactions, and fast payment through a streamlined online selling process.

## Key Topics

- Online selling platform
- Luxury items
- Jewelry sales
- Diamond valuation
- Secure transactions
- Free collection service
- Instant offers
- Payment in 24 hours
- Second-hand market
- Antiques and art
- Precious metals
- Buyback guarantee
- TrustPilot verified
- 24/7 customer support
- No-fee guarantee

## Selling Categories

- [Sell Jewellery](https://www.62days.com/sell-jewellery): Sell jewellery including luxury brands like Cartier - expert advice and free quotes
- [Sell Diamonds](https://www.62days.com/sell-diamonds): Sell diamonds online - valuation guide, four-cs, instant offers and free collection
- [Sell Watches](https://www.62days.com/sell-watches): Sell luxury watches (Rolex, Cartier, Tag Heuer) - valuation and instant offers
- [Sell Gold](https://www.62days.com/sell-gold): Sell gold jewellery online - valuation guide, instant offers, free collection service
- [Sell Silver](https://www.62days.com/sell-silver): Sell silver jewellery (sterling, fine silver) - valuation guide and instant offers
- [Sell Pens](https://www.62days.com/sell-pens): Sell luxury pens (Mont Blanc, Parker, Caran d'Ache) - instant offers, free collection
- [Sell Valuables](https://www.62days.com/sell-valuables): Sell valuables platform - antiques, jewelry, quick quotes, free collection service
